args.message: Here is each store's best 2025 month by pre-tax sales (net sales, converted from cents to dollars), with how far it beat that store's average month. I averaged only over the months each store had sales, which matches its opening date: Los Angeles had 2 months (opened 2025-11-11) and New Orleans had 8 (opened 2025-05-08). The other four stores were open all 12 months. Four stores peaked in December 2025; Brooklyn peaked in March and Philadelphia in January.
